name: mv_gl_monthly_account_summary
columns: month date, account_code text, account_name text, drawer bigint, debit_amount_myr numeric, credit_amount_myr numeric
definition:
SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, je.posting_date::date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
    jl.account_code,
    a.account_name,
    a.drawer,
    sum(jl.debit_amount_myr) AS debit_amount_myr,
    sum(jl.credit_amount_myr) AS credit_amount_myr
   FROM sap_gl_journal_lines jl
     JOIN sap_gl_journal_entries je ON jl.trans_id = je.trans_id
     JOIN sap_gl_accounts a ON jl.account_code = a.account_code
  WHERE je.trans_type <> '-3'::text
  GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, je.posting_date::date::timestamp with time zone)::date), jl.account_code, a.account_name, a.drawer;

name: mv_gl_monthly_balance_sheet_snapshot
columns: month date, account_code text, account_name text, drawer bigint, cumulative_balance_myr numeric
definition:
WITH monthly_movement AS (
         SELECT date_trunc('month'::text, je.posting_date::date::timestamp with time zone)::date AS month,
            jl.account_code,
            a.account_name,
            a.drawer,
            sum(jl.debit_amount_myr - jl.credit_amount_myr) AS net_movement_myr
           FROM sap_gl_journal_lines jl
             JOIN sap_gl_journal_entries je ON jl.trans_id = je.trans_id
             JOIN sap_gl_accounts a ON jl.account_code = a.account_code
          WHERE (a.drawer = ANY (ARRAY[1::bigint, 2::bigint, 3::bigint])) AND je.trans_type <> '-3'::text
          GROUP BY (date_trunc('month'::text, je.posting_date::date::timestamp with time zone)::date), jl.account_code, a.account_name, a.drawer
        )
 SELECT month,
    account_code,
    account_name,
    drawer,
    sum(net_movement_myr) OVER (PARTITION BY account_code ORDER BY month) AS cumulative_balance_myr
   FROM monthly_movement;

name: mv_sales_projection_ensemble
comment: Frozen copy of v_sales_projection_ensemble -- the published blend. The view measured 4,202 ms to produce twelve rows and ran on every page load. UNLIKE THE OTHER CACHES THIS ONE FREEZES THE CALENDAR: period_month is derived from current_date, so a cache built last month names the wrong month for horizon=1, and get_sales_projections silently DROPS that row rather than erroring. Refreshed daily at 00:20 MYT by refresh-sales-projection-ensemble-daily for exactly that reason. cache_refreshed_at is the only staleness marker these forward rows carry.
columns: period_month date, horizon integer, projected numeric, coverage numeric, order_book_weight numeric, implied_from_order_book numeric, implied_from_apriori numeric, within_var numeric, between_var numeric, total_var numeric, sd numeric, lo_80 numeric, hi_80 numeric, lo_95 numeric, hi_95 numeric, composed_var numeric, band_origins bigint, model_detail jsonb, cache_refreshed_at timestamp with time zone

SELECT period_month,
    horizon,
    projected,
    coverage,
    order_book_weight,
    implied_from_order_book,
    implied_from_apriori,
    within_var,
    between_var,
    total_var,
    sd,
    lo_80,
    hi_80,
    lo_95,
    hi_95,
    composed_var,
    band_origins,

   FROM v_sales_projection_ensemble v;

definition:
WITH app_events AS (
         SELECT aa.id::text AS activity_id,
            aa.employee_id AS employee_uuid,
            e.employee_id AS company_employee_code,
            e.full_name,
            date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS work_date,
            'App'::text AS event_source,
            at.name AS attendance_type,
            aa.clocked_in_at AS check_in_time,
            aa.clocked_out_at AS check_out_time,
            aa.approval_status::text AS approval_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.clocked_out_at IS NULL THEN 'Missing Check-Out'::text
                    ELSE 'Valid'::text
                END AS activity_audit_flag,
            NULL::numeric AS day_fraction,
            NULL::text AS remarks,
            aa.attendance_type_id,
            aa.photo_url,
            aa.notes,
            aa.entry_method,
            aa.adjustment_reason_id
           FROM attendance_activities aa
             JOIN employees e ON aa.employee_id = e.id
             LEFT JOIN attendance_types at ON aa.attendance_type_id = at.id
        ), hw_events AS (
         SELECT md5((e.id::text || COALESCE(h.scanner_location, 'HW'::text)) || date((h.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text))::text) AS activity_id,
            e.id AS employee_uuid,
            h.employee_id AS company_employee_code,
            e.full_name,
            date((h.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS work_date,
            'Hardware'::text AS event_source,
            COALESCE(h.scanner_location, 'On-Site'::text) AS attendance_type,
            min(h.scanned_at) AS check_in_time,
            NULLIF(max(h.scanned_at), min(h.scanned_at)) AS check_out_time,
            'System Verified'::text AS approval_status,
                CASE
                    WHEN count(*) = 1 THEN 'Incomplete Scans'::text
                    ELSE 'Valid'::text
                END AS activity_audit_flag,
            NULL::numeric AS day_fraction,
            NULL::text AS remarks,
            NULL::bigint AS attendance_type_id,
            NULL::text AS photo_url,
            NULL::text AS notes,
            NULL::text AS entry_method,
            NULL::bigint AS adjustment_reason_id
           FROM attendance_logs h
             JOIN employees e ON h.employee_id = e.employee_id
          GROUP BY e.id, h.employee_id, e.full_name, h.scanner_location, (date((h.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)))
        ), leave_events AS (
         SELECT 'leave-'::text || le.id::text AS activity_id,
            le.employee_id AS employee_uuid,
            e.employee_id AS company_employee_code,
            e.full_name,
            le.leave_date AS work_date,
            'Leave'::text AS event_source,
            ('On Leave ('::text || lt.code) || ')'::text AS attendance_type,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS check_in_time,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS check_out_time,
            'Approved'::text AS approval_status,
            'On Leave'::text AS activity_audit_flag,
            le.day_fraction,
            le.remarks,
            NULL::bigint AS attendance_type_id,
            NULL::text AS photo_url,
            NULL::text AS notes,
            NULL::text AS entry_method,
            NULL::bigint AS adjustment_reason_id
           FROM leave_ledger_entries le
             JOIN leave_ledger_types lt ON lt.id = le.leave_type_id
             JOIN employees e ON e.id = le.employee_id
        ), holiday_events AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.id, ph.holiday_date) 'holiday-'::text || ph.id::text AS activity_id,
            e.id AS employee_uuid,
            e.employee_id AS company_employee_code,
            e.full_name,
            ph.holiday_date AS work_date,
            'Holiday'::text AS event_source,
            ('Public Holiday ('::text || ph.name) || ')'::text AS attendance_type,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS check_in_time,
            NULL::timestamp with time zone AS check_out_time,
            'Approved'::text AS approval_status,
            'Public Holiday'::text AS activity_audit_flag,
            NULL::numeric AS day_fraction,
            NULL::text AS remarks,
            NULL::bigint AS attendance_type_id,
            NULL::text AS photo_url,
            NULL::text AS notes,
            NULL::text AS entry_method,
            NULL::bigint AS adjustment_reason_id
           FROM public_holidays ph
             JOIN employees e ON ph.work_location_id = e.work_location_id OR ph.work_location_id IS NULL
             JOIN employment_status es ON es.id = e.employment_status_id AND es.category = 'active'::text
          ORDER BY e.id, ph.holiday_date, ph.work_location_id
        ), all_events AS (
         SELECT app_events.activity_id,
            app_events.employee_uuid,
            app_events.company_employee_code,
            app_events.full_name,
            app_events.work_date,
            app_events.event_source,
            app_events.attendance_type,
            app_events.check_in_time,
            app_events.check_out_time,
            app_events.approval_status,
            app_events.activity_audit_flag,
            app_events.day_fraction,
            app_events.remarks,
            app_events.attendance_type_id,
            app_events.photo_url,
            app_events.notes,
            app_events.entry_method,
            app_events.adjustment_reason_id
           FROM app_events
        UNION ALL
         SELECT hw_events.activity_id,
            hw_events.employee_uuid,
            hw_events.company_employee_code,
            hw_events.full_name,
            hw_events.work_date,
            hw_events.event_source,
            hw_events.attendance_type,
            hw_events.check_in_time,
            hw_events.check_out_time,
            hw_events.approval_status,
            hw_events.activity_audit_flag,
            hw_events.day_fraction,
            hw_events.remarks,
            hw_events.attendance_type_id,
            hw_events.photo_url,
            hw_events.notes,
            hw_events.entry_method,
            hw_events.adjustment_reason_id
           FROM hw_events
        UNION ALL
         SELECT leave_events.activity_id,
            leave_events.employee_uuid,
            leave_events.company_employee_code,
            leave_events.full_name,
            leave_events.work_date,
            leave_events.event_source,
            leave_events.attendance_type,
            leave_events.check_in_time,
            leave_events.check_out_time,
            leave_events.approval_status,
            leave_events.activity_audit_flag,
            leave_events.day_fraction,

            leave_events.photo_url,
            leave_events.notes,
            leave_events.entry_method,
            leave_events.adjustment_reason_id
           FROM leave_events
        UNION ALL
         SELECT holiday_events.activity_id,
            holiday_events.employee_uuid,
            holiday_events.company_employee_code,
            holiday_events.full_name,
            holiday_events.work_date,
            holiday_events.event_source,

            holiday_events.photo_url,
            holiday_events.notes,
            holiday_events.entry_method,
            holiday_events.adjustment_reason_id
           FROM holiday_events
        )

name: documents_with_context
comment: Project-scoped document library listing, with aggregated linked-task ids/titles so a page can show "linked to: Task A, Task B" without an N+1 query per document. security_invoker=true is load-bearing -- without it this view would leak every project's documents to every authenticated user regardless of documents/projects/task_documents RLS.
columns: id uuid, project_id uuid, project_name text, drive_file_id text, name text, url text, mime_type text, icon_url text, attached_by uuid, attached_by_name text, attached_at timestamp with time zone, linked_task_ids uuid[], linked_task_titles text[], linked_task_count bigint
definition:
SELECT d.id,
    d.project_id,
    p.name AS project_name,
    d.drive_file_id,
    d.name,
    d.url,
    d.mime_type,
    d.icon_url,
    d.attached_by,
    e.full_name AS attached_by_name,
    d.attached_at,
    COALESCE(lt.linked_task_ids, '{}'::uuid[]) AS linked_task_ids,
    COALESCE(lt.linked_task_titles, '{}'::text[]) AS linked_task_titles,
    lt.linked_task_count
   FROM documents d
     JOIN projects p ON p.id = d.project_id
     LEFT JOIN employees e ON e.id = d.attached_by
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT array_agg(t.id ORDER BY t.created_at) AS linked_task_ids,
            array_agg(t.title ORDER BY t.created_at) AS linked_task_titles,
            count(*) AS linked_task_count
           FROM task_documents td
             JOIN tasks t ON t.id = td.task_id
          WHERE td.document_id = d.id) lt ON true;

name: employee_lifecycle_cases_with_progress
comment: Per-case completed(DONE+SKIPPED)/total item progress %, backing CaseCard/ProgressBar/OverviewCards KPIs. NULL progress_percentage means the case has no seeded items yet (should not happen in practice -- get_or_create_*_case() always seeds the full fixed set atomically).
columns: id uuid, employee_id uuid, case_type lifecycle_case_type, status lifecycle_case_status, opened_at timestamp with time zone, opened_reason text, expected_last_day date, employee_can_view boolean, closed_at timestamp with time zone, closed_reason text, it_revocation_reminder_last_notified_at timestamp with time zone, overdue_last_notified_at timestamp with time zone, created_at timestamp with time zone, updated_at timestamp with time zone, total_item_count bigint, skipped_item_count bigint, completed_item_count bigint, progress_percentage numeric
definition:
SELECT c.id,
    c.employee_id,
    c.case_type,
    c.status,
    c.opened_at,
    c.opened_reason,
    c.expected_last_day,
    c.employee_can_view,
    c.closed_at,
    c.closed_reason,
    c.it_revocation_reminder_last_notified_at,
    c.overdue_last_notified_at,
    c.created_at,
    c.updated_at,
    count(i.id) AS total_item_count,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = 'SKIPPED'::lifecycle_item_status) AS skipped_item_count,
    count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = ANY (ARRAY['DONE'::lifecycle_item_status, 'SKIPPED'::lifecycle_item_status])) AS completed_item_count,
        CASE
            WHEN count(i.id) = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * count(i.id) FILTER (WHERE i.status = ANY (ARRAY['DONE'::lifecycle_item_status, 'SKIPPED'::lifecycle_item_status]))::numeric / count(i.id)::numeric)
        END AS progress_percentage
   FROM employee_lifecycle_cases c
     LEFT JOIN employee_lifecycle_case_items i ON i.case_id = c.id
  GROUP BY c.id;

name: employees_public
columns: id uuid, full_name text, preferred_name text, email_work text, phone_work numeric, employment_status text, position text, department_id bigint, department_name text, employee_id text, profile_id uuid, address_work text, nationality_id bigint, nationality_name text, employment_type_id bigint, employment_type_name text, avatar_url text, manager_id uuid, manager_name text, manager_employee_id text, manager_profile_id uuid, manager_preferred_name text, manager_position text, manager_phone numeric, manager_email text, manager_address_work text, manager_avatar_url text, manager_department_name text, employment_status_name text, employment_status_category text, manager_employment_status_name text, current_status text, last_status_time text, first_arrival_time text, current_attendance_id uuid, current_attendance_type_id bigint, is_on_leave_today boolean, leave_type_codes_today text, work_location_name text, work_location_code text, personal_address_line1 text, personal_address_line2 text, personal_address_city text, personal_address_state text, personal_address_postcode text, personal_address_country text
definition:
SELECT e.id,
    e.full_name,
    e.preferred_name,
    e.email_work,
    e.phone_work,
    e.employment_status,
    e."position",
    e.department_id,
    d.name AS department_name,
    e.employee_id,
    e.profile_id,
    e.address_work,
    e.nationality_id,
    n.name AS nationality_name,
    e.employment_type_id,
    et.name AS employment_type_name,
    p.avatar_url,
    e.manager_id,
    m.full_name AS manager_name,
    m.employee_id AS manager_employee_id,
    m.profile_id AS manager_profile_id,
    m.preferred_name AS manager_preferred_name,
    m."position" AS manager_position,
    m.phone_work AS manager_phone,
    m.email_work AS manager_email,
    NULL::text AS manager_address_work,
    mp.avatar_url AS manager_avatar_url,
    md.name AS manager_department_name,
    es.name AS employment_status_name,
    es.category AS employment_status_category,
    mes.name AS manager_employment_status_name,
        CASE
            WHEN app.latest_event_time IS NOT NULL AND app.clocked_out_at IS NOT NULL AND app.latest_event_time = app.clocked_out_at AND (hw.scanned_at IS NULL OR app.latest_event_time > hw.scanned_at) THEN 'Offline'::text
            WHEN app.latest_event_time IS NOT NULL AND (hw.scanned_at IS NULL OR app.latest_event_time > hw.scanned_at) THEN app.type_name
            WHEN hw.scanned_at IS NOT NULL THEN hw.scanner_location
            WHEN lv.leave_type_codes IS NOT NULL THEN ('On Leave ('::text || lv.leave_type_codes) || ')'::text
            ELSE 'Offline / Not Arrived'::text
        END AS current_status,
    to_char((GREATEST(app.latest_event_time, hw.scanned_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text), 'HH12:MI AM'::text) AS last_status_time,
    to_char((LEAST(first_app.first_app_time, first_hw.first_hw_time) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text), 'HH12:MI AM'::text) AS first_arrival_time,
    app.id AS current_attendance_id,
    app.attendance_type_id AS current_attendance_type_id,
    lv.leave_type_codes IS NOT NULL AS is_on_leave_today,
    lv.leave_type_codes AS leave_type_codes_today,
    wl.name AS work_location_name,
    wl.sub AS work_location_code,
    pa.line1 AS personal_address_line1,
    pa.line2 AS personal_address_line2,
    pa.city AS personal_address_city,
    pa.state AS personal_address_state,
    pa.postcode AS personal_address_postcode,
    pa.country AS personal_address_country
   FROM employees e
     LEFT JOIN profiles p ON p.id = e.profile_id
     LEFT JOIN departments d ON d.id = e.department_id
     LEFT JOIN employees m ON m.id = e.manager_id
     LEFT JOIN profiles mp ON mp.id = m.profile_id
     LEFT JOIN departments md ON md.id = m.department_id
     LEFT JOIN employment_status es ON es.id = e.employment_status_id
     LEFT JOIN employment_status mes ON mes.id = m.employment_status_id
     LEFT JOIN nationalities n ON n.id = e.nationality_id
     LEFT JOIN employment_type et ON et.id = e.employment_type_id
     LEFT JOIN work_locations wl ON wl.id = e.work_location_id
     LEFT JOIN addresses pa ON pa.id = e.personal_address_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT a.id,
            a.attendance_type_id,
            at.name AS type_name,
            a.clocked_in_at,
            a.clocked_out_at,
            GREATEST(a.clocked_in_at, COALESCE(a.clocked_out_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone)) AS latest_event_time
           FROM attendance_activities a
             LEFT JOIN attendance_types at ON a.attendance_type_id = at.id
          WHERE a.employee_id = e.id AND date((a.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) = CURRENT_DATE
          ORDER BY (GREATEST(a.clocked_in_at, COALESCE(a.clocked_out_at, '1970-01-01 00:00:00+00'::timestamp with time zone))) DESC
         LIMIT 1) app ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT attendance_logs.scanner_location,
            attendance_logs.scanned_at
           FROM attendance_logs
          WHERE attendance_logs.employee_id = e.employee_id AND date((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) = CURRENT_DATE
          ORDER BY attendance_logs.scanned_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) hw ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(attendance_activities.clocked_in_at) AS first_app_time
           FROM attendance_activities
          WHERE attendance_activities.employee_id = e.id AND date((attendance_activities.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) = CURRENT_DATE) first_app ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(attendance_logs.scanned_at) AS first_hw_time
           FROM attendance_logs
          WHERE attendance_logs.employee_id = e.employee_id AND date((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) = CURRENT_DATE) first_hw ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT string_agg(DISTINCT lt.code, '+'::text ORDER BY lt.code) AS leave_type_codes
           FROM leave_ledger_entries le
             JOIN leave_ledger_types lt ON lt.id = le.leave_type_id
          WHERE le.employee_id = e.id AND le.leave_date = CURRENT_DATE) lv ON true;

name: project_progress
comment: Per-project completed/total-non-cancelled progress %, req #9. NULL (not 0) progress_percentage means zero non-cancelled tasks exist yet.
columns: project_id uuid, total_task_count bigint, cancelled_task_count bigint, active_task_count bigint, completed_task_count bigint, progress_percentage numeric
definition:
SELECT p.id AS project_id,
    count(t.id) AS total_task_count,
    count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'CANCELLED'::task_status) AS cancelled_task_count,
    count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status <> 'CANCELLED'::task_status) AS active_task_count,
    count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED'::task_status) AS completed_task_count,
        CASE
            WHEN count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status <> 'CANCELLED'::task_status) = 0 THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE round(100.0 * count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status = 'COMPLETED'::task_status)::numeric / count(t.id) FILTER (WHERE t.status <> 'CANCELLED'::task_status)::numeric)
        END AS progress_percentage
   FROM projects p
     LEFT JOIN tasks t ON t.project_id = p.id
  GROUP BY p.id;

columns: doc_entry bigint, invoice_date date, customer_code text, customer_name text, local_export_flag text, sales_rep_code bigint, invoiced_myr numeric, gross_profit_myr numeric, doc_myr_ratio numeric, invoiced_before_tax_myr numeric
definition:
SELECT i.doc_entry,
    NULLIF(i.invoice_date, ''::text)::date AS invoice_date,
    i.customer_code,
    COALESCE(sc.customer_name, i.customer_name) AS customer_name,
    sc.local_export_flag,
    i.sales_rep_code,
    i.total_amount_myr AS invoiced_myr,
        CASE
            WHEN i.total_amount_myr <> 0::numeric AND abs(i.gross_profit) > (abs(i.total_amount_myr) * 5::numeric) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE i.gross_profit
        END AS gross_profit_myr,
        CASE
            WHEN i.total_amount <> 0::numeric THEN i.total_amount_myr / i.total_amount
            ELSE 1::numeric
        END AS doc_myr_ratio,
    i.total_amount_myr - COALESCE(i.tax_amount, 0::numeric) AS invoiced_before_tax_myr
   FROM sap_invoices i
     LEFT JOIN sap_customers sc ON sc.customer_code = i.customer_code
  WHERE i.is_cancelled = 'N'::text;

WITH closing AS (
         SELECT sales_leads_stage_history.lead_id,
            max(sales_leads_stage_history.changed_at) AS closed_at
           FROM sales_leads_stage_history
          WHERE sales_leads_stage_history.new_stage = ANY (ARRAY['WON'::sales_leads_stage, 'LOST'::sales_leads_stage])
          GROUP BY sales_leads_stage_history.lead_id
        ), classified AS (
         SELECT sl_1.id,
            sl_1.client_id,
            sl_1.lead_owner_id,
            sl_1.title,
            sl_1.description,
            sl_1.close_probability,
            sl_1.expected_revenue,
            sl_1.lose_reason_id,
            sl_1.cancel_reason,
            sl_1.hold_reason,
            sl_1.notes,
            sl_1.created_at,
            sl_1.updated_at,
            sl_1.lead_source_type_id,
            sl_1.is_on_hold,
            sl_1.stage,
            sl_1.is_cancelled,
            sl_1.actual_revenue,
            sl_1.po_number,
            sl_1.po_document_url,
            sl_1.quotation_url,
            sl_1.product_type,
            sl_1.sap_customer_code,
                CASE
                    WHEN sl_1.is_cancelled OR sl_1.stage = 'LOST'::sales_leads_stage THEN 'lost'::text
                    WHEN sl_1.stage = 'WON'::sales_leads_stage THEN 'won'::text
                    ELSE 'open'::text
                END AS outcome
           FROM sales_leads sl_1
        )
 SELECT sl.id AS lead_id,
    sl.outcome,
    sl.stage::text AS stage,
    sl.is_on_hold,
    (sl.created_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)::date AS created_on,
        CASE
            WHEN sl.outcome <> 'open'::text THEN (COALESCE(c.closed_at, sl.updated_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)::date
            ELSE NULL::date
        END AS closed_on,
    sl.lead_owner_id AS owner_employee_id,
    COALESCE(sl.client_id::text, sl.sap_customer_code) AS account_key,
    COALESCE(cl.name, sc.customer_name) AS account_name,
    sl.product_type,
    sl.lead_source_type_id,
    COALESCE(lst.name, 'Unspecified'::text) AS lead_source,
        CASE
            WHEN sl.outcome = 'lost'::text THEN
            CASE
                WHEN sl.is_cancelled THEN 'Cancelled'::text
                ELSE COALESCE(lr.name, 'No reason given'::text)
            END
            ELSE NULL::text
        END AS lost_reason,
    sl.expected_revenue AS expected_myr,
    sl.close_probability,
        CASE
            WHEN sl.outcome = 'won'::text THEN sl.actual_revenue
            ELSE NULL::numeric
        END AS won_myr,
    sl.po_number,
    COALESCE(sl.outcome = 'won'::text AND sl.po_number IS NOT NULL AND NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM sap_sales_orders sso
          WHERE sso.customer_ref = sl.po_number)), false) AS pending_sap_order,
    COALESCE(sl.is_cancelled, false) AS is_cancelled
   FROM classified sl
     LEFT JOIN closing c ON c.lead_id = sl.id
     LEFT JOIN clients cl ON cl.id = sl.client_id
     LEFT JOIN sap_customers sc ON sc.customer_code = sl.sap_customer_code
     LEFT JOIN lead_source_types lst ON lst.id = sl.lead_source_type_id
     LEFT JOIN sales_leads_lose_reasons lr ON lr.id = sl.lose_reason_id;

definition:
SELECT so.doc_entry,
    so.so_number,
    so.order_date,
    so.delivery_date,
    so.created_at,
    so.updated_at,
    so.status_code,
    so.is_cancelled,
    so.customer_code,
    so.customer_name,
    so.sales_rep_code,
    so.owner_code,
    so.ship_to_code,
    so.customer_ref,
    so.total_amount,
    so.currency,
    so.total_amount_myr,
    so.exchange_rate,
    so.gross_profit,
    so.discount_pct,
    COALESCE(lf.total_open_qty, 0::numeric) AS total_open_qty,
    COALESCE(lf.total_delivered_qty, 0::numeric) AS total_delivered_qty,
    COALESCE(lf.total_open_qty, 0::numeric) <= 0::numeric AS is_fully_delivered,
    COALESCE(di.delivery_count, 0::bigint) AS delivery_record_count,
    COALESCE(ir.matched_invoice_count, 0::bigint) AS matched_invoice_count,
    COALESCE(ir.total_invoiced_myr, 0::numeric) AS total_invoiced_myr,
    COALESCE(ir.total_paid_myr, 0::numeric) AS total_paid_myr,
    COALESCE(ir.total_applied_myr, 0::numeric) AS total_applied_myr,
    COALESCE(ir.total_outstanding_myr, 0::numeric) AS total_outstanding_myr,
    abs(COALESCE(ir.total_paid_myr, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ir.total_applied_myr, 0::numeric)) > 0.01 AS has_paid_mismatch,
    COALESCE(ir.matched_invoice_count, 0::bigint) > 0 AND COALESCE(ir.total_outstanding_myr, 0::numeric) <= 0.01 AS is_fully_paid,
    (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM sales_leads sl
          WHERE sl.po_number = so.customer_ref)) AS has_matched_lead
   FROM sap_sales_orders so
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT COALESCE(sum(sap_sales_order_lines.open_qty), 0::numeric) AS total_open_qty,
            COALESCE(sum(sap_sales_order_lines.delivered_qty), 0::numeric) AS total_delivered_qty
           FROM sap_sales_order_lines
          WHERE sap_sales_order_lines.doc_entry = so.doc_entry) lf ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*) AS delivery_count
           FROM sap_deliveries d
             JOIN sap_delivery_lines dl ON dl.doc_entry = d.doc_entry
          WHERE dl.base_entry = so.doc_entry AND dl.base_type = 17 AND d.is_cancelled = 'N'::text) di ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( WITH matched_invoice_ids AS (
                 SELECT DISTINCT il.doc_entry
                   FROM sap_invoice_lines il
                  WHERE il.base_entry = so.doc_entry AND il.base_type = 17
                UNION
                 SELECT DISTINCT il2.doc_entry
                   FROM sap_delivery_lines dl2
                     JOIN sap_invoice_lines il2 ON il2.base_entry = dl2.doc_entry AND il2.base_type = 15
                  WHERE dl2.base_entry = so.doc_entry AND dl2.base_type = 17
                )
         SELECT count(*) AS matched_invoice_count,
            COALESCE(sum(i.total_amount_myr), 0::numeric) AS total_invoiced_myr,
            COALESCE(sum(i.paid_to_date), 0::numeric) AS total_paid_myr,
            COALESCE(sum(i.applied_payment_myr), 0::numeric) AS total_applied_myr,
            COALESCE(sum(i.outstanding_balance), 0::numeric) AS total_outstanding_myr
           FROM matched_invoice_ids m
             JOIN sap_invoices_with_balance i ON i.doc_entry = m.doc_entry
          WHERE i.is_cancelled = 'N'::text) ir ON true;

            EXTRACT(isodow FROM d.work_date) = ANY (ARRAY[6::numeric, 7::numeric]) AS is_weekend
           FROM employees e
             JOIN employment_status es ON es.id = e.employment_status_id AND es.category = 'active'::text
             CROSS JOIN active_company_dates d
        ), daily_hardware AS (
         SELECT attendance_logs.employee_id AS scanner_emp_id,
            date((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS work_date,
            min((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS hw_check_in,
            max((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS hw_check_out,
            count(*) AS total_hw_scans,
            round(EXTRACT(epoch FROM max(attendance_logs.scanned_at) - min(attendance_logs.scanned_at)) / 3600::numeric, 2) AS hw_hours,
            min(attendance_logs.scanned_at) AS hw_check_in_ts,
            max(attendance_logs.scanned_at) AS hw_check_out_ts
           FROM attendance_logs
          WHERE attendance_logs.scanned_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - '2 years'::interval)
          GROUP BY attendance_logs.employee_id, (date((attendance_logs.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)))
        ), daily_hw_remote_overlap AS (
         SELECT e.id AS app_emp_uuid,
            date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS work_date,
            sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.clocked_out_at IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0::numeric, EXTRACT(epoch FROM LEAST(aa.clocked_out_at, h.hw_check_out_ts) - GREATEST(aa.clocked_in_at, h.hw_check_in_ts)))
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) / 3600::numeric AS overlap_hours
           FROM attendance_activities aa
             JOIN employees e ON e.id = aa.employee_id
             CROSS JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT min(al.scanned_at) AS hw_check_in_ts,
                    max(al.scanned_at) AS hw_check_out_ts
                   FROM attendance_logs al
                  WHERE al.employee_id = e.employee_id AND date((al.scanned_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) = date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text))) h
          WHERE aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text AND h.hw_check_in_ts IS NOT NULL
          GROUP BY e.id, (date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)))
        ), daily_app AS (
         SELECT aa.employee_id AS app_emp_uuid,
            date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)) AS work_date,
            min(
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text THEN (aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
                END) AS app_check_in,
            max(
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text THEN (COALESCE(aa.clocked_out_at, aa.clocked_in_at) AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)
                    ELSE NULL::timestamp without time zone
                END) AS app_check_out,
            string_agg(((at.name || ' ('::text) || aa.approval_status::text) || ')'::text, ', '::text ORDER BY aa.clocked_in_at) AS daily_activities,
            bool_or(aa.clocked_out_at IS NULL AND aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text) AS has_missing_app_checkout,
            bool_and(aa.approval_status::text = 'Approved'::text) AS all_approved,
            bool_or(aa.approval_status::text = 'Pending'::text) AS has_pending,
            bool_or(aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text) AS has_any_non_rejected,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.approval_status::text <> 'Rejected'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM aa.clocked_out_at - aa.clocked_in_at)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) / 3600::numeric, 2) AS app_hours,
            round(sum(
                CASE
                    WHEN aa.approval_status::text = 'Approved'::text THEN EXTRACT(epoch FROM aa.clocked_out_at - aa.clocked_in_at)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END) / 3600::numeric, 2) AS approved_app_hours
           FROM attendance_activities aa
             LEFT JOIN attendance_types at ON aa.attendance_type_id = at.id
          WHERE aa.clocked_in_at >= (CURRENT_DATE - '2 years'::interval)
          GROUP BY aa.employee_id, (date((aa.clocked_in_at AT TIME ZONE 'Asia/Kuala_Lumpur'::text)))
        ), daily_holiday AS (
         SELECT DISTINCT ON (e.id, ph.holiday_date) e.id AS holiday_emp_uuid,
            ph.holiday_date AS work_date,
            ph.name AS holiday_name
           FROM employees e
             JOIN employment_status es ON es.id = e.employment_status_id AND es.category = 'active'::text
             JOIN public_holidays ph ON ph.work_location_id = e.work_location_id OR ph.work_location_id IS NULL
          ORDER BY e.id, ph.holiday_date, ph.work_location_id
        ), final_rows AS (
         SELECT u.employee_uuid,
            u.company_employee_code,
            u.full_name,
            p.avatar_url,
            u."position",
            u.employment_status_id,
            u.department_id,
            d.name AS department_name,
            u.manager_id,
            m.full_name AS manager_name,
            u.work_date,
            h.hw_check_in,
            h.hw_check_out,
            h.total_hw_scans,
            a.app_check_in,
            a.app_check_out,
            a.daily_activities,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) AS hours_worked,
            ( SELECT min(t.v) AS min
                   FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_in), (h.hw_check_in)) t(v)) AS first_in,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.app_check_out IS NULL AND COALESCE(h.total_hw_scans, 0::bigint) = 1 THEN NULL::timestamp without time zone
                    ELSE ( SELECT max(t.v) AS max
                       FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_out), (h.hw_check_out)) t(v))
                END AS last_out,
            (( SELECT min(t.v) AS min
                   FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_in), (h.hw_check_in)) t(v)))::time without time zone AS first_in_time_of_day,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.app_check_out IS NULL AND COALESCE(h.total_hw_scans, 0::bigint) = 1 THEN NULL::timestamp without time zone
                    ELSE ( SELECT max(t.v) AS max
                       FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_out), (h.hw_check_out)) t(v))
                END::time without time zone AS last_out_time_of_day,
            dl.leave_type_codes IS NOT NULL AS is_on_leave,
            dl.leave_type_codes,
            dl.leave_day_fraction_total AS leave_day_fraction,
                CASE
                    WHEN u.is_weekend OR dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric - 8::numeric)
                END AS overtime_hours,
            COALESCE(NOT u.is_weekend AND dh.holiday_name IS NULL AND dl.leave_emp_uuid IS NULL AND NOT (a.app_check_out IS NULL AND COALESCE(h.total_hw_scans, 0::bigint) = 1) AND GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) < 8::numeric AND (( SELECT max(t.v) AS max
                   FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_out), (h.hw_check_out)) t(v)))::time without time zone < COALESCE(wl.early_leave_time, '17:00:00'::time without time zone), false) AS is_early_leave,
            u.work_location_id,
            wl.name AS work_location_name,
            COALESCE(NOT u.is_weekend AND dh.holiday_name IS NULL AND dl.leave_emp_uuid IS NULL AND GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) < 8::numeric AND (( SELECT min(t.v) AS min
                   FROM ( VALUES (a.app_check_in), (h.hw_check_in)) t(v)))::time without time zone > '09:00:00'::time without time zone, false) AS is_late_arrival,
            COALESCE(dl.leave_day_fraction_total >= 1::numeric AND (h.hw_check_in IS NOT NULL OR a.app_check_in IS NOT NULL), false) AS is_leave_attendance_conflict,
            COALESCE(NOT u.is_weekend AND dh.holiday_name IS NULL AND dl.leave_day_fraction_total = 0.5 AND (GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric)) < 4::numeric, false) AS is_insufficient_half_day_hours,
            COALESCE(dl.leave_day_fraction_total > 1::numeric, false) AS has_leave_fraction_error,
            dl.paid_leave_day_fraction,
            dl.unpaid_leave_day_fraction,
            dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL AS is_public_holiday,
            dh.holiday_name AS public_holiday_name,
            COALESCE(dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL AND (h.hw_check_in IS NOT NULL OR a.app_check_in IS NOT NULL), false) AS is_worked_on_holiday,
                CASE
                    WHEN dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS holiday_hours_worked,
            u.is_weekend,
            COALESCE(u.is_weekend AND (h.hw_check_in IS NOT NULL OR a.app_check_in IS NOT NULL), false) AS is_worked_on_weekend,
                CASE
                    WHEN u.is_weekend THEN GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric)
                    ELSE 0::numeric
                END AS weekend_hours_worked,
            8::numeric AS normal_hours_threshold,
            GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) AS true_hours_worked,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT u.is_weekend THEN NULL::text
                    WHEN (GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN NULL::text
                    WHEN (GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) <= (8.0 / 2::numeric) THEN 'half_day'::text
                    ELSE 'full_day'::text
                END AS rest_day_wage_tier,
                CASE
                    WHEN NOT u.is_weekend THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric - 8::numeric)
                END AS rest_day_excess_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN dh.holiday_name IS NULL THEN NULL::text
                    WHEN (GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric) <= 0::numeric THEN NULL::text
                    ELSE 'full_day'::text
                END AS holiday_wage_tier,
                CASE
                    WHEN dh.holiday_name IS NULL THEN 0::numeric
                    ELSE GREATEST(0::numeric, GREATEST(0::numeric, COALESCE(h.hw_hours, 0::numeric) - COALESCE(ro.overlap_hours, 0::numeric)) + COALESCE(a.app_hours, 0::numeric) - 1::numeric - 8::numeric)
                END AS holiday_excess_hours,
                CASE
                    WHEN u.is_weekend AND dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'weekend_public_holiday'::text
                    WHEN u.is_weekend THEN 'weekend'::text
                    WHEN dh.holiday_name IS NOT NULL THEN 'public_holiday'::text
                    ELSE 'ordinary'::text
                END AS day_calendar_type,
            NOT u.is_weekend AND dh.holiday_name IS NULL AS is_expected_working_day,
                CASE
                    WHEN dl.leave_emp_uuid IS NULL THEN 'none'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(dl.leave_day_fraction_total, 0::numeric) > 1::numeric THEN 'over_full_day'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(dl.leave_day_fraction_total, 0::numeric) >= 1::numeric THEN 'full_day'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(dl.leave_day_fraction_total, 0::numeric) = 0.5 THEN 'half_day'::text
                    ELSE 'partial'::text
                END AS leave_state,
                CASE
                    WHEN h.hw_check_in IS NOT NULL AND a.app_check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'both'::text
                    WHEN h.hw_check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'hardware'::text
                    WHEN a.app_check_in IS NOT NULL THEN 'app'::text
                    ELSE 'none'::text
                END AS evidence_source,
                CASE
                    WHEN h.hw_check_in IS NULL AND a.app_check_in IS NULL THEN 'none'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(h.total_hw_scans, 0::bigint) = 1 AND COALESCE(a.has_missing_app_checkout, false) THEN 'single_scan_and_open_session'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(h.total_hw_scans, 0::bigint) = 1 THEN 'single_scan'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.has_missing_app_checkout, false) THEN 'open_session'::text
                    ELSE 'complete'::text
                END AS evidence_quality,
                CASE
                    WHEN a.app_emp_uuid IS NULL THEN 'not_applicable'::text
                    WHEN NOT COALESCE(a.has_any_non_rejected, false) THEN 'rejected_only'::text
                    WHEN COALESCE(a.has_pending, false) THEN 'pending'::text
                    ELSE 'approved'::text
                END AS approval_state
           FROM expected_shifts u
             LEFT JOIN daily_hardware h ON u.company_employee_code = h.scanner_emp_id AND u.work_date = h.work_date
             LEFT JOIN daily_hw_remote_overlap ro ON u.employee_uuid = ro.app_emp_uuid AND u.work_date = ro.work_date
             LEFT JOIN daily_app a ON u.employee_uuid = a.app_emp_uuid AND u.work_date = a.work_date
             LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT max(le.employee_id::text)::uuid AS leave_emp_uuid,
                    sum(le.day_fraction) AS leave_day_fraction_total,
                        CASE
                            WHEN count(DISTINCT le.leave_type_id) = 1 THEN max(lt.code)
                            ELSE string_agg(DISTINCT lt.code, '+'::text ORDER BY lt.code)
                        END AS leave_type_codes,
                    sum(le.day_fraction) FILTER (WHERE lt.is_paid) AS paid_leave_day_fraction,
                    sum(le.day_fraction) FILTER (WHERE NOT lt.is_paid) AS unpaid_leave_day_fraction
                   FROM leave_ledger_entries le
                     JOIN leave_ledger_types lt ON lt.id = le.leave_type_id
                  WHERE le.employee_id = u.employee_uuid AND le.leave_date = u.work_date) dl ON true
             LEFT JOIN daily_holiday dh ON u.employee_uuid = dh.holiday_emp_uuid AND u.work_date = dh.work_date
             LEFT JOIN departments d ON u.department_id = d.id
             LEFT JOIN employees m ON u.manager_id = m.id
             LEFT JOIN profiles p ON u.profile_id = p.id
             LEFT JOIN work_locations wl ON wl.id = u.work_location_id
        ), day_rows AS (

            fr_1.is_insufficient_half_day_hours,

                CASE fr_1.day_calendar_type
